warnings: [taste_coherence] The Italian flavor profile is classic and well-conceived, but because the recipe relies strictly on no-salt-added canned goods, low-sodium broth, and zero added salt, it may taste noticeably flat. The computed sodium is only 155 mg per serving. Suggest adding 1/4 tsp kosher salt to step 3; this will enhance the flavors while keeping the sodium (~300 mg per serving) safely under the 500 mg ceiling.

[cooking_method_suitability] In step 2, adding minced garlic at the exact same time as raw chicken and onions over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes risks scorching the garlic before the chicken finishes cooking. Fix: Add the minced garlic during the final 1 minute of browning.

details.summary: This is an exceptionally strong, well-formulated recipe that nails both the book's dietary philosophy and the 30-minute practicality promise. With a minor adjustment to when the garlic is added to prevent scorching and a small pinch of salt to round out the flavors, it is ready for publication.
